_what: Dose ranges for the BMAL1 cross-model comparison, measured 2026-09-01 (tag zoo03).
_two_kinds: per_model: each model's OWN best range -- lo at its identity departure, hi at whichever
ceiling binds (integrator stability, or the dose above which the clock has not relaxed
within a skip we are willing to pay), span capped by the 3-decade rule. Puts that
model's S_crit at ~30% of its own log range, which is what reading twist wants.
THIS IS THE DEFAULT FOR ANY SINGLE-MODEL WORK.
shared: ONE range per mode across all three models, so a cross-model figure can use a
common y-axis. Capped at the most sensitive model and floored low enough that the
first dose row is still the identity in EVERY model. The cost is that S_crit no longer
sits at 30% -- it lands at 40-60% -- so the type-0 side is under-sampled relative to
the per-model grids. Narrow purpose: the BMAL1 comparison figure only.
